body:
Feed, soap, and a clean jar, paid cash. My note below says a medicinal odor came from the sprayer trial.

The driver grew dizzy at dawn, and the verge grass he walked through had gone gray.
title: Receipt with note

body: I heard three shots, then the person taking statements told me the file would say two. He said the third sound might have come from a car door. I put a mark beside it, because the woman on the ground heard it too.
title: Notepad page
